test_cases.title: init(max=0) clamps to max=1, no NaN
test_cases.description: Verify that init with max=0 produces currentLimit=1 and deriveProfile returns valid numerics
steps: assert deriveProfile(1, 1) returns climbThreshold=4, dropThreshold=3, cooldownMs=20000

test_cases.title: syncProvider(max_concurrency=0) clamps to 1
test_cases.description: Verify that syncProvider with max_concurrency=0 produces currentLimit=1

test_cases.title: High watermark climbs without limitReached
test_cases.description: Verify limit=8 with max=10 climbs to 9 after climbThreshold successes without wasQueued

test_cases.title: Cooldown blocks drops but not climbs
test_cases.description: Verify that after 429 drops limit, successes during cooldown can climb back

test_cases.title: 429 uses fixed -1 drop
test_cases.description: Verify 429 drops exactly 1 slot regardless of current limit

test_cases.title: 10 rapid 429s only drop 1 slot
test_cases.description: Verify cooldown prevents cascading drops from burst 429s

test_cases.title: At-max success counter halves instead of resetting
test_cases.description: Verify consecutiveSuccesses=floor(n/2) when limit already at max

test_cases.title: Full recovery from limit=1 to max=10
test_cases.description: Verify 36 consecutive successes recover limit from 1 to 10

test_cases.title: Cooldown failure does not reset success counter
test_cases.description: Verify that a failure during cooldown does not clear consecutiveSuccesses

test_cases.title: 5xx drop triggers cooldown
test_cases.description: Verify that 5xx path enters cooldown after dropping

test_cases.title: E15 scenario: rapid recovery during cooldown
test_cases.description: Verify E15 from design doc - 429 then 5 successes during cooldown fully recover

test_cases.title: E18 scenario: success interrupts failure chain
test_cases.description: Verify E18 - alternating success/failure does not trigger drop
